headline: Draft bodyworks ordinance adding licenses and inspections, aimed at human trafficking, presented for review.
summary: Staff gave a communicable disease update and plans vaccine clinics, including one at the Veterans Day Parade. The draft bodyworks rules would require licenses for practitioners and establishments, unannounced inspections, and open waiting areas. A final vote is hoped for in February, with enactment in March.
discussion: Bodyworks scope: Members asked how many illicit places operate in the city, and staff estimated 25 to 30 at any time among 50 to 75 bodyworks places overall.
Trafficking victim support: Members asked what help would be offered to people found during inspections, and staff said protocols with inspectors and police were being set up.
Bodyworks certifications: Members questioned whether each practice needs its own certification or whether a general sanitation standard should apply.
Vaccine outreach: Members asked whether the church-based network used for COVID outreach is still active, and staff said it would be part of upcoming conversations.
